data.DESCRIPTION: The investigation done revealed that the LWs.1 is working as SI of Police, LWs.2 to 4 are the police personals  working in PS Mills colony, LW-5 is weighing dry ganja, LW-6 is the Photographer. Whereas the accused A-1 is the younger brother of the A2 and A-3 hail from different areas. The accused persons are unsatisifed with their legal earnings and started doing illegal Ganja business. As the A-1 was addicted to lavishes and as the money coming out of his earnings is not enough to meet his lavishes, he came to know that some persons will sell the Ganja at a low rate in Sambalpur, Orissa and sell the same at a high rate in Solapur, Maharashtra. In that regard when A-1 informed the same to his sister A-2 Sushma Patel by doing phone call, she also agreed with him and in this connection when A-1 went to their house, his sister A-2 Sushma Patel's daughter's birthday was performed in the year January month. Where at that time, along with his brother-in-law, A-3 Uday Singh Gurjar, S/o Mohan Singh, R/o Machipura Village, Bucholai Post, Sawai Madhavpur District and State of Rajasthan also came there. When A-1 told A-3 about said business, he also agreed. As per their intension they went to Sambalpur in Orissa state by train as no one can suspect them and bought a total of 18 Kgs from an unknown person at the rate of Rs.5000/- per KG with an intention to sell the same for Rs..25000/- in Orissa. Accordingly the A-1 to A3 boarded Train in Orrissa, get down at Vizag and boarded the Konark Express train to go to Solapur. When they reached Warangal, they got down at Warangal railway station and at the same time while the police were searching the train, they were scared and get down in Railway station. While the accused persons were proceeding by walk, at the same time as the police were conducting patrolling and as they thought that they were looking for them and when the accused persons tried to escape, the police party suspected and apprehended them. The accused A1 to A3 confessed the matter in Hindi language and the A-1 to A3 shown their bags found they found 4 cover wrapped in brown cover. On that torn said cover and on opening they found dry Ganja in it which they will sell it to the unknown persons at higher rate of Rs 25000/- per kg containing Total Ganja arounds 18 Kgs Total worth Rs.4,50000/-.

Jani Pasha, SI of Police, PS Nekkonda, submitted a report in Telugu stating that, today i.e. on 28-10-2023 at 10:30 hours, he left from police station along with PC- 1285 and 1619 for conducting the patrolling in Nekkonda village, at about 11:00 hrs, while they proceeding to newly constructing Nekkonda Railway station building, they found one person under suspicious circumstances, who carrying two bags, on seeing the Police party, he tried to escape from that place, upon which Police party chased and apprehended him and found coming Ganja smell from that bags. Later, served the notice of 50(b) of NDPS Act to said person. Later, sent a requisition to Tahsildar of Nekkonda through PC-79 with a request to visit the scene of offence along panch witnesses and telephoned to the photographer Thatipamula Venkateshwarlu and Thoudishetty Ravinder, requested them to visit the scene of offence to take video graph and weighing the dray Ganja. Kaeitha Sammaiah s/o Chennaiah, Age: 73yrs, Caste: Mudiraj, Occ: VRA, r/o Suripally (v), Nekkonda (M) and interrogated said apprehended person. As usually he purchased 16.300 kgs of Ganja from Dhinesh Bhaina at Odisha state and same is transporting to Hyderabad, he came to Vijayawada by train, from there he came to Nekkonda through train and apprehended by Police. After completion of the confession and seizure panchanama, returned to PS at 13:20 hours along with the apprehended person and above seized material and produced him requesting to take necessary legal action against the apprehended person as per law.
